combination: One composite only; conflicting directions flat, same side deduplicated using listed priority, one shared reservation through actual exit quote. No individual-cell economic selection.
decision: Primary passive s1 vs flat and matched LONG in both funding scenarios: all four simultaneous lower bounds above1 bps per selected opportunity and positive solvent risk-scaled economics give GO; any required upper bound below1 gives NO_GO; otherwise INKONKLUSIV. GO means propose prospective execution research only.
entry_clock: Signal bar start+300 seconds; first actual later-or-equal M5 open. Target is known_at+60min or London17:00. Expired signals and end-censored positions remain counted.
inference_family: 72 endpoints: active minus matched LONG, passive minus matched LONG, passive versus flat; four slip scenarios x two funding scenarios x raw opportunity bps / ATR14-normalized opportunity bps / calendar-day Sharpe difference.
limitations: Five cells were chosen post hoc from61 earlier cells; this reused period and current72-endpoint correction do not undo historical selection.
M5 opposite-side quote touch is an idealized fill condition, not queue position, actual fill, latency, market impact, or traded volume evidence.
Passive fill time is assumed bar end; actual touch time within the five-minute bar is unknown. Financing uses that assumption.
Historical EFFR plus1.29pp is a research funding proxy, not verified historical broker swaps.
Source gaps are preserved. Terminal exposure is valued/liquidated at the last available pre-TEST close with exit costs; censored count is disclosed.

Year2026 raw source contains a boundary beyond the permitted outcomes. Full-file bytes are hashed for identity, while decoded price rows are filtered to bar_start<2026-07-01. No TEST split is opened or outcome evaluated.
Risk uses the last fully closed canonical D1 return window21, target10percent annual vol, leverage cap1 and fixed initial capital; realized risks need not match.
Raw/ATR opportunity means and calendar-day Sharpe are different estimands; bootstrap power is a conditional location-shift precision diagnostic, not future trading power.
passive_model: Place buy at decision bid_open / sell at ask_open; complete next M5 bar only, strictly before scheduled exit. Touch uses ask_low <= buy_limit or bid_high >= sell_limit. Assume entry at limit and bar-end time; no entry slippage. All nonfills stay in shared cohort.
population_classification: Entire evaluation is reused development history, not untouched holdout.
